title: Théorie arithmétique. Théorie de Galois des motifs (1965) : notes manuscites (s.d.), tapuscrit (s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
This page is not Grothendieck's mathematics. It is page '-7-' of a typed Bourbaki draft (rédaction n°370), photographed upside down; the sheet is scrap paper reused for the motif notes on the neighbouring pages. The text belongs to the existence proof of Haar measure on a locally compact group G, in the Weil/Cartan/Bourbaki form (Intégration, ch. VII, §1).

Notation:
- K is the space of continuous functions with compact support; K_+ its positive part; K*_+ its nonzero positive elements.
- K*_+(V) is the set of those elements with support in V.
- γ(s) is left translation, (γ(s)g)(t) = g(s^{-1}t).
- (f:g) is Haar's covering index: the infimum of Σ c_i over all majorations f ≤ Σ c_i γ(s_i) g with c_i ≥ 0.

The page proves the following properties.
- (iv) sup f ≤ (f:g) sup g. Evaluate the majoration at a point where f reaches its maximum.
- (v) Submultiplicativity, (f:h) ≤ (f:g)(g:h). Compose the two majorations.
- (vi) Applying (v) twice gives 1/(f0:f) ≤ (f:g)/(f0:g) ≤ (f:f0).
- (vii) Approximate additivity for g with small support: (f:g) + (f':g) ≤ (f+f':g) + ε(h:g) for g ∈ K*_+(V), where V is a small enough neighbourhood of e.

Proof of (vii):
- Set F = f + f' + ½εh. Then φ = f/F and φ' = f'/F lie in K_+, are uniformly continuous, and satisfy φ + φ' ≤ 1.
- For g supported in V one has φ·γ(s)g ≤ (φ(s)+η)γ(s)g.
- From any majoration of F by translates of g this gives (f:g) + (f':g) ≤ (1+2η)(F:g).
- Subadditivity (ii), homogeneity (iii) and (v) then give the bound, once η is chosen with η[2(f+f':h)+ε] ≤ ε/2.

The page ends with the setup for passing to the limit. The sets K*_+(V), as V runs over compact neighbourhoods of e, form a filter base; take an ultrafilter finer than it. The limit of (f:g)/(f0:g) along the ultrafilter then defines a left Haar measure.

ideas.what: Haar covering index (f:g) and its properties: submultiplicativity, comparison bounds, approximate additivity for small supports
ideas.modern_name: Weil–Cartan proof of existence of Haar measure
ideas.usually_credited_to: Haar (1933), Weil (1940), H. Cartan (1940); Bourbaki Intégration ch. VII (1963)

ideas.what: Defining Haar measure as an ultrafilter limit of the ratios (f:g)/(f0:g) as supp g shrinks to e
ideas.modern_name: Ultrafilter / compactness construction of Haar measure

deep.surprise_reason: The page is the verso of a typed Bourbaki draft (n°370) on the existence of Haar measure, used as scrap paper. Its content is the standard, correct, published Bourbaki proof and has no connection to the motivic notes.
